nodes.name: Business Hours Cron
nodes.notes: Every 2h, 09:00-19:00, Mon-Sat. Sends stage-based follow-up questions to owning agents.

parameters.query:
-- Expire prompts unanswered for >3 days so they stop blocking new cadence and feed the weekly report.
UPDATE lead_followups SET status='expired'
WHERE status='pending' AND prompt_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
RETURNING id;
SELECT conversation_id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_number, lead_name, lead_phone, property_title, operation, stage, prompt_kind FROM leads_needing_followup;

-- Record the sent prompt (creates the pending tracker row) and log the outbound message.
WITH ins AS (
  SELECT record_followup_sent($1::uuid, $2, $3) AS followup_id
)
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, metadata)
SELECT $1::uuid, 'outbound', 'system', $4, $5,
       jsonb_build_object('purpose','followup_question','prompt_kind',$3,'followup_id',ins.followup_id)
FROM ins
RETURNING conversation_id;

nodes.name: Send OK?
nodes.notes: Only record the pending tracker row if Evolution accepted the send. On failure (continueOnFail puts an `error` object on the item) the lead is left untracked so it reappears next sweep.
